edits.value_json: “备” means “prepare,” “be ready or complete,” and “equipment.” Its modern visible split is 夂 above 田, but that split is not established as its historical construction. Traditional 備 is interpreted either as a person carrying a container or as a whole container holding arrows.
夂 is the visible upper part of modern 备; its historical role in this graph is unresolved.
田 is the visible lower part of modern 备; its historical role in this graph is unresolved.
